scopeWarnings: All six listed majors are Chinese-taught; the generic English-language paragraph does not create English tracks.
No HSK numerical score is printed; do not fill 180 or 210.
The HSK4 CSCA Professional Chinese exemption names 汉语言本科, whereas row 1 is 汉语国际教育; do not transfer the exemption.
HSK substitute proof is an application for a waiver using both junior and senior secondary Chinese-medium evidence, not automatic exemption.
The age-25 reference date is not stated; September 1, 2027 belongs only to the under-18 guardian clause.
The guide gives registration in late August–early September but does not literally name the intake season; conservative intake other is valid.
No explicit application time zone is printed.
The six table row numbers are not official major codes.
The optional veterinary sixth major is five years, not four; it must retain CSCA Chemistry rather than Physics.
